text:
Oncall-Bot: PAGE — GPU pool eu-west-1/gpu-heavy at 96% utilization, queue length > 1200 for 5m. Autoscaler attempted scale but failed: ScaleAttemptError(max_replicas_reached). :rotating_light:
Sofia (oncall): I'm taking this. Spawning terminal and pulling autoscaler logs now.
Raj: I'll check provider console and cluster state. Do we have any hot spare capacity?
Ashley: Support: seeing elevated 429s and 503s for inference endpoints in EU. Initial impact estimate: ~25% of requests affected, highest on embeddings. Notifying major customers now.
Oncall-Bot: Autoscaler logs excerpt: ```ERROR autoscaler controller: heartbeat missed 3 times
ScaleAttemptError: quota_exceeded (provider quota 256 GPUs)
Trace: controller/autoscaler/scale.go:142
```
Marta: Can someone check if a recent autoscaler rollout happened in last 2 hours? I remember a resource change merged.
Raj: Looking — yes, autoscaler v1.10.1 rolled out 1h ago, new GC tuning and memory bump. Controller pods show `OOMKilled` on controller-3.
Infra-Chris: If autoscaler is unstable we can do manual pool creation and route traffic there temporarily. Command I use: `rctl infra create-pool --name eu-temphot --gpus a100:8 --count 8 --region eu-west-1` — need ops approval for immediate spend.
Sofia (oncall): Action plan initial: 1) Start manual hot pool 2) Shift 15-25% low-priority traffic to us-west-2 fallback 3) Apply throttles to low-priority tenants 4) Rollback autoscaler to stable if needed. Who's on it?
Ashley: I'll draft a customer-facing blurb: "We're currently experiencing capacity constraints in EU resulting in higher error rates. We're rebalancing traffic and bringing temporary capacity. High-commit customers prioritized — ETA 15-30 minutes for mitigation." Will post update after we confirm routing.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Sofia (oncall).
Marta: I pulled controller logs. Frequent full GCs correlated with controller heap growth after the 1.10.1 change. Suspect memory regressor.
Raj: Provider console shows 254/256 GPUs used; 6 VMs stuck in provisioning state (status PENDING). I can force-cancel and free them if safe.
Sofia (oncall): Raj, do that. Infra-Chris, please kick off the hot pool. Ashley, send initial customer note. Marta, prepare to rollback autoscaler if OOMs continue.
Infra-Chris: Hot pool creation started. ETA ~11m for nodes to pass health checks.
Raj: Canceled stuck provider VMs, freed 6 GPUs. Provider API returned intermittent 403s earlier (rate-limited on quota ops). Raising ticket with provider now.
Marta: Rolling autoscaler back to v1.9.3: `kubectl set image deployment/autoscaler autoscaler=autosc:v1.9.3 -n infra` — starting rollout.
Support-Lead: Pushed targeted messages to 7 impacted high-touch customers; CustomerOps preparing escalation playbooks.
Sofia (oncall): Implemented nginx rate limits on embed endpoints to protect core traffic: `limit_req zone=embed burst=100 nodelay`. Also started staggered routing: 15% -> eu-temphot, 20% -> us-west-2 fallback.
Oncall-Bot: Monitoring — queue length trending down: 1500 -> 420 within 12m. Error rate decreased from ~25% -> ~9%.
Raj: Provider ticket ACKed. They've increased API concurrency for us and are investigating stuck provisioning.
Marta: Autoscaler rollback completed, controller pods back to stable memory profile and heartbeat restored. No more OOMKills after restart.
Infra-Chris: eu-temphot pool passed health checks and accepted traffic. Confirmed GPUs available.
Ashley: Second customer update drafted and posted: "Mitigation in progress; we've provisioned temporary capacity and rolled back a recent autoscaler change. Expect progressive improvement; we'll update in 30 minutes."
Support-Lead: Logging follow-up: record which tenants were throttled, reconcile any SLA impacts, coordinate credits if needed.
Sofia (oncall): Post-incident immediate checklist (assignments): collect autoscaler metrics (Marta), provider quota timeline & API errors (Raj), customer impact list + messages (Ashley + Support-Lead), runbook gaps (Eng-Runbooks).
Eng-Runbooks: Noted. We'll update runbook steps for manual pool creation and automated fallback routing.
Marta: Opening PR to add liveness/readiness probes to autoscaler, raise memory requests to avoid OOM, and revert recent GC tuning until we have controlled load tests.
Raj: I'll request provider soft limit bump to 320 GPUs for eu-west-1 and ask for quota-alert hooks so we get early warning instead of silent failures.
Sofia (oncall): Action items and timeline: - PRs for autoscaler probes and resource changes (Marta) — target: PR today. - Provider quota bump request (Raj) — follow up today. - Update alerts: add 5m-smoothed queue growth alert and a fallback automation runbook (Eng-Runbooks) — target: Tomorrow. - Postmortem doc with timeline and customer impact (Sofia + Ashley) — draft by EOD tomorrow.
Marta: I'll also add a pre-deploy integration test to simulate quota-limited conditions so we don't ship autoscaler regressions silently.
Infra-Chris: Recommend we also add health-check gating for autoscaler rollouts in CI to prevent memory regressions slipping through.
Sofia (oncall): We'll keep monitoring for next 40m; if queue stays stable we move to 'mitigated' and then produce postmortem. Great job coordinating — clean handoff to oncall rotation at 09:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Oncall-Bot: Incident status: MITIGATED -> monitoring. Metrics snapshot attached in incident log.
